title: micro1 Pay Index: AI Trainer Pay by Field
subtitle: Monthly advertised hourly pay for micro1 AI training roles, by field
description: Monthly snapshot of advertised hourly pay for AI training roles on micro1, by field. October 2026 (snapshot 2026-10-24): 270 open hourly roles, median posted range $50–$90/hr; Science & Research has the highest median top rate ($200/hr), then Law ($170/hr) and Finance ($150/hr). Advertised ranges only, not earnings. Methodology: https://www.artificialjobs.dev/pay-index/2026-10#methodology

resources.description: October 2026 edition, one row per field
